sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
LexJet is a provider of printing supplies, media, and resources for large-format and specialty printing applications.

Industry: Printing · Size: <$50M · Products: Sunset Photo Metallic Paper, Sunset Photo eSatin Paper, LexJet Print-N-Stick Fabric, Sunset Select Canvas

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: LexJet scores 72 of 100 (tier B) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (28/30), application fit (25/25) and event engagement (15/15). Nothing was found for pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (27% similar on printing, print, vinyl, graphics); Drytac (21% similar on print, graphics, media, printing); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (16% similar on graphics, vinyl, vehicle, protection). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
